control._why: Shattered Acolyte kills artifacts/enchantments, Sheltered by Ghosts exiles a permanent and protects a creature. Cuts creature removal (Chainsaw) and Basilisk Collar.

midrange._why: Sheltered by Ghosts removes a blocker and protects a threat.

aggro._why: Seam Rip and Sheltered by Ghosts remove their early threats. Cuts Skateboard and the hexproof equipment (less needed vs creature decks). (added 2026-11-23 for the meta round robin)
